title: Collect a file request
description: Issue an upload destination, then let a recipient upload without your operator token.

sections.title: Create the request
paragraphs: The operator runs this authenticated call. Copy the token from the returned request URL and give the URL to the recipient.

sections.title: Upload as the recipient
paragraphs: This call uses the request token, not the operator token. The server saves the upload to the destination chosen when the request was issued.
sections.code:
export REQUEST_TOKEN="<token-from-issued-url>"
curl --fail-with-body -X PUT \
  -H "X-Loft-Name: notes.txt" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain" \
  --data-binary @notes.txt \
  "$LOFT_API/r/$REQUEST_TOKEN"

sections.title: Close when finished
paragraphs: Use the request record ID with DELETE /v1/sharing/:link. Existing uploads remain in your storage; future uploads through the closed request are rejected.
